profile_text.body:
Dell Technologies is a public company founded in 1984 and headquartered in Round Rock, Texas, United States. Its website describes the company as providing technology solutions, services and support, and lists laptops, touch screen PCs, desktops, servers, storage, monitors, gaming and accessories. The site highlights XPS 13 and Dell 14 Plus laptops, and describes Dell Premier as a way for organizations to customize their IT experience.

On the AI side, Dell's site promotes Copilot+ PCs, which it describes as combining powerful performance, built-in intelligence, and all-day battery life. The site also includes a chat interface with prompts for current deals, laptop recommendations, order tracking, technical support, and sales.

Dell Technologies trades under the ticker DELL and has SEC CIK number 0001571996. The company appears in 126 Texas legal exposure records.
